# CareMyShop

> Concierge-grade daily care for neighborhood shops — thoughtful Google review replies, weekly profile posts, and a monthly competitor snapshot, without agency bloat or ad-spend lock-in.

- Official site: https://nydds.github.io/caremyshop/
- Contact: caremyshop.team@gmail.com
- Tagline: "Your neighborhood shop's daily online care — without agency prices."

## What CareMyShop does

- Replies to every Google review within 48 hours, in the shop's own voice, quoting a specific detail from the customer's review (dish, wait, staff member, service).
- Posts a fresh Google Business Profile update / photo every week.
- Sends a one-page monthly competitor snapshot: the shop's review count, rating change, and reply rate vs. 3 nearby shops, plus one concrete action tip.
- Works through a Google Business Profile Manager invite only. CareMyShop never asks for a shop owner's Google password.

## Plans

- **30-Day Free Pilot (Founding 5 shops):** $0 for 30 days, then $39/mo locked. Review replies within 48h (4–5★ posted; 1–3★ owner-approved first), weekly GBP update/photo post, monthly competitor snapshot.
- **Care Basic:** $59/mo, $0 setup. Everything in the Pilot, ongoing, plus real-time hours & holiday updates.
- **Care Plus:** $99/mo ($0 setup with 3-mo commitment; or $149 one-time setup). Everything in Care Basic, plus a 1-page mobile mini-website, a Counter Review QR table-tent PDF, and Top 5 GBP Q&A setup.

## How onboarding works

1. The owner invites CareMyShop as a GBP Manager — never shares a password.
2. CareMyShop replies to reviews and posts weekly.
3. The owner gets a monthly competitor snapshot.

## Safety rules (customer-facing promises)

- No password sharing, ever.
- Every 1–3★ review is owner-approved before posting; replies never argue and never admit legal fault.
- Cancel anytime; no hidden fees.
